title: dryas octopetala subsp. oxyodonta
intro: Dryas octopetala subsp. oxyodonta, commonly known as Arctic Five-Petal or Mountain Avens, is a flowering plant that belongs to the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is valued for its traditional use in herbal medicine, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help soothe wounds, reduce inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Arctic Five-Petal include astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it effective in treating skin issues, wounds, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
